name: Investigator Forensic Physician — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Investigator Forensic Physician from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Forensic Science" but are not part of the Investigator Forensic Physician entry, which is unchanged.

S-class investigators dedicated to forensic science may or may not also have a background in alchemy, but regardless, they are experts in the fields of medicine and physicology.

Medical Expertise (Ex)

If the check succeeds by 5 or more, the target is healed 1d8+1 hit points of damage for every two investigator levels instead.
If the check fails by 5 or more, the target suffers damage equal to its level (minimum 3). This damage can’t be prevented or redirected in any way, but it can be healed.

At 5th level, the investigator can choose to increase the Heal check DC to 20 and increase the amount he heals his target for by 1d6 on a success or 1d8+1 on a success by 5 or more. He can increase the DC to 25 at 11th level, and 30 at 17th level. Each time, he increases his healing by another 2d6 on a success or 2d8+2 on a success by 5 or more, for a total of 5d6 additional healing on a success or 5d8+5 additional healing on a success by 5 or more.

The investigator can use this ability once per day per target, or he can spend 2 inspiration and use it on the same target again after 1 minute instead.
